name: Variety Show - Volunteers & Important Info
description: We're gearing up for our upcoming Variety Show and need parent volunteers to help make it a success! Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands, Concession Organizer, and providing a digital keyboard. Audition videos are due by 3/1, dress rehearsal is 3/19, and the show is on 3/20.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided.

name: Yearbook Orders

name: Middle School Selection Process
